items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And another guy that was the top man for Perry Como was a song plugger. I got to know him later.

ctx.x: He was one of them guys I used to see come up there and talk to you. He was a song plugger. He used to (?) all the big movie stars.
And another guy that was the top man for Perry Como was a song plugger. I got to know him later. I had a way of knowing people that meant something. I don't know why. It's just a habit of mine.
